title: fix(plugin-security): translate the built-in positions under zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMLTWJMvQQWZ5RaZFnBdwkB)_

Fixes #26562

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：平台内置的七个岗位（平台管理员、组织所有者、组织管理员、组织成员、组织外部成员、全体成员、访客）在中文、日文、西班牙文界面下，名称和说明都按当前语言显示。
- **为什么改**：设置 → 岗位在中文界面下，应用自己的岗位已是中文，平台内置的七个仍是英文，其中包括每条授权都要参照的「全体成员」「访客」。内置权限集早已翻译，岗位漏掉了。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只新增翻译包里的 `positions` 组，英文、岗位本身的定义与授权都不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/builtin-positions.ts`（三种语言的译文）；`translations/index.ts`（三行接入）；`translations/builtin-positions.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/translations/builtin-positions.test.ts`，预期 29/29 通过；或中文界面打开 设置 → 岗位，内置七项显示中文。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/translations/builtin-positions.ts`: hand-authored `positions.NAME.label` / `.description` for the seven built-in positions (`platform_admin`, `org_owner`, `org_admin`, `org_member`, `org_external`, `everyone`, `guest`) in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES, the locales the built-in permission-set group (`permission-sets.ts`) covers. Hand-authored for the reason that file gives: this package's extract runs objects-only, so `os i18n extract` writes no `positions` group. English needs no entry (an untranslated locale serves the declaration's own text). Terms follow this bundle's objects: 岗位 / ポジション / puesto.
- `translations/index.ts`: each translated locale of `SecurityTranslations` gains `positions` beside `permissions`, outside `withSourceFallback`'s inputs exactly like the permission-set group (`enSource` carries neither, so nothing is judged stale).
- New `translations/builtin-positions.test.ts`: per locale, the group translates exactly the declared built-ins, no two labels repeat, each label and description is a non-English string naming no machine id, and `translateMetadataDocument('position', declaration, SecurityTranslations, { locale })` serves that locale's label and description with nothing else of the position changed.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch.

No `packages/spec/**` change.

## Why

Card #26562 (triage 6437681727, p2): under zh-CN, Setup → Positions (`/_console/apps/setup/metadata/position`) listed the app's positions in Chinese and the platform's seven in English.

Reader measured before writing the bundle: the page reads `GET /api/v1/meta/position`, whose list read (`translateMetaList` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) runs `translateMetadataDocument('position', …)` with the i18n service's merged bundle; that dispatches to `translatePosition` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`), which reads `positions.NAME.label` / `.description`. `SecurityPlugin` loads `SecurityTranslations` into that service at `kernel:ready`. So the reader existed and the bundle was missing, as the card says. The built-ins reach the door as registry declarations (`builtin-positions.ts`, `registerBuiltinPositions`), keyed by `name`, which is what the group keys on.

## Tests

Red first on `main` (`a14f3e61`): the new test, before the bundle was added: `Tests 27 failed | 2 passed (29)` (every per-locale case; the two population checks pass). On the fix: `Tests 29 passed (29)`.

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck at the fix</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security build && … typecheck && … test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `Test Files 230 passed (230)`, `Tests 4991 passed | 45 skipped (5036)`.
Lint: `eslint packages/plugins/plugin-security --no-inline-config` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `everyone` reads 全体成员 / 全メンバー / Todos, since the description says every authenticated member holds it; `guest` reads 访客 / ゲスト / Invitado.
- zh-CN `org_admin` (组织管理员) shares its text with the `organization_admin` permission set's label. They are on different pages and name the same people, so it is left as is.
- A live probe was not run: the served overlay is proven in-process through the same `translateMetadataDocument` the REST door calls.

## Verification

Head `352780c3` (the gate loop started on `65852aec`, the same tree before a commit-message reword; `git diff 65852aec 352780c3` is empty).

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: `61 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.

Three families first answered exit 3 (prerequisite, nothing measured) and were re-run after their prerequisite, each exit 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` after `git fetch --unshallow origin main` (48 cases pass); `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after a full `turbo run build` (VERDICT command-exit 0): `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`.

`test:repo` not run locally (the diff touches no repo-project test); CI Test Core runs it. No dogfood battery: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
